snapshot.title: Time Jump: 12:00 PM — Lab Sample Verification

fields.narration: Facilitator reads aloud: 'It is now 12:00 PM on Saturday, October 24, 2026. The team has completed manual verification of Zone 3 water quality using grab samples. The lab has confirmed no overfeed and no contamination. The Public Information Officer is preparing to issue the Boil Water Advisory. The Director of Water Operations has authorized the next phase of recovery.'
worldState: The lab has completed manual grab sampling from Zone 3.
Chlorine residual is 0.3 mg/L, turbidity is 0.1 NTU — within normal limits.
No overfeed detected in any chemical system.
Chain of custody for all samples is recorded on paper per SOP 8.3.
The lab has sent the paper lab sheet to the Control Room via secure fax.
The Public Information Officer has the Boil Water Advisory draft and is preparing to publish.
The Control Room has confirmed that all manual readings match the original setpoint limits in MDWS-SCADA-APP-A.
The emergency response phase is now transitioning to public notification and verification.
fields.facilitatorNote: This time jump confirms that the lab's manual verification has been completed and accepted. The team must now confirm that the advisory is issued correctly and that no system integrity issues remain before restoring full operations.
